name: Cape Town Summer 2020

venue.name: Kirstenhof Primary School
venue.address: 18 Lente St, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, South Africa

information:
Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association web site before attending the competion in order to speed up the registration process on the day. 

This will be a 2 day competition. Entry fee for the 2 days will be R150.00, or R100.00 per day if you are only interested in competing in the events on a single day only.
